steps.name: Enter XSS payload in username
steps.action: Type <script>alert('xss')</script> into the username field and submit the login form
steps.expected: Input is sanitized or escaped, no script execution occurs, error message shows sanitized text without rendering HTML, no alert dialog appears

steps.name: Verify DOM integrity
steps.action: Inspect the DOM around the username field and any error message elements
steps.expected: No injected script tags in the DOM, error message uses textContent not innerHTML, React JSX escaping prevents XSS

steps.name: Enter XSS payload in password
steps.action: Type "> into the password field and submit
steps.expected: Input is treated as plain text, no image element created, no onerror fires, form shows invalid credentials error safely

steps.name: Paste extremely long password
steps.action: Paste a 10000-character string into the password field and submit the form
steps.expected: Form either truncates input to a reasonable limit or submits and receives a 400/413 error from the API, UI does not freeze or crash, no browser tab hang

steps.name: Verify UI responsiveness
steps.action: Attempt to interact with other page elements during and after paste
steps.expected: Page remains responsive, no excessive memory consumption, no visible layout shift from the password field

steps.name: Disconnect network and attempt login
steps.action: Set browser to offline mode (DevTools Network tab), fill valid credentials admin/admin123, click submit
steps.expected: Login request fails, user sees a clear network error message such as 'Network error' or 'Unable to connect to server', submit button re-enables, no infinite spinner

steps.name: Reconnect and retry
steps.action: Re-enable network and click submit again without re-entering credentials
steps.expected: Login succeeds on retry, redirect to /dashboard, credentials were preserved in form fields

challenges.name: Login with Expired Token in localStorage

steps.name: Set expired token in localStorage
steps.action: Manually set localStorage token to an expired JWT (exp claim in the past), then navigate to /dashboard
steps.expected: AuthProvider detects expired token, user is redirected to /login page, expired token is cleared from localStorage

steps.name: Verify no flash of authenticated content
steps.action: Observe the transition from load to redirect
steps.expected: No dashboard content flashes before redirect, loading state or blank screen shown during auth check, then clean redirect to /login

steps.name: Navigate to /login with returnUrl pointing to /login
steps.action: Navigate to /login?returnUrl=%2Flogin
steps.expected: After successful login, user is redirected to /dashboard (default) instead of /login, no infinite redirect loop occurs

steps.name: Test deeply nested redirect
steps.action: Navigate to /login?returnUrl=%2Flogin%3FreturnUrl%3D%252Flogin
steps.expected: Redirect loop is detected and broken, user lands on /dashboard

steps.name: Submit login from external origin
steps.action: Create an HTML page on a different origin that auto-submits a form POST to http://localhost:3000/api/v1/auth/login
steps.expected: Request is blocked by CORS policy or SameSite cookie restrictions, login does not succeed from cross-origin form submission

challenges.name: Session Hijacking via Manual Token Edit

steps.name: Modify JWT token in localStorage
steps.action: Login as admin, then manually edit the JWT token payload in localStorage (change username to 'superadmin' or modify role claims), then refresh the page
steps.expected: Modified token fails JWT signature verification on next API call, user is logged out and redirected to /login, tampered token is cleared

steps.name: Replace with fabricated token
steps.action: Set localStorage token to a completely fabricated JWT string signed with a wrong secret
steps.expected: All API calls return 401 Unauthorized, AuthProvider detects invalid token and redirects to /login

steps.name: Attempt login with disabled account
steps.action: Submit login form with credentials for a disabled/deactivated user account
steps.expected: Login is rejected with a specific error message like 'Account is disabled' or generic 'Invalid credentials', no JWT is issued, user remains on /login page

steps.name: Login from multiple tabs simultaneously
steps.action: Open 5 browser tabs, login as admin in each tab in rapid succession
steps.expected: All tabs successfully authenticate, localStorage token is consistent across tabs (last login wins), no race condition causes token corruption

steps.name: Verify cross-tab state sync
steps.action: Logout from one tab
steps.expected: Other tabs detect the logout (via storage event listener or next API call) and redirect to /login, no stale authenticated state persists

steps.name: Corrupt token while on dashboard
steps.action: While on /dashboard, use DevTools to set localStorage token to 'corrupted-not-a-jwt'
steps.expected: On next API call or periodic token check, AuthProvider detects invalid token format, triggers logout, redirects to /login

steps.name: Set token to empty string
steps.action: Set localStorage token to ''
steps.expected: Application treats empty string as no token, redirects to /login, no error thrown in console

steps.name: Enter SQL injection payload
steps.action: Type ' OR '1'='1' -- into the username field, type anything in password, submit
steps.expected: Login fails with invalid credentials error, no SQL injection occurs, API uses parameterized queries, no database error exposed to client

steps.name: Programmatically switch routes rapidly
steps.action: Use browser console to rapidly call history.pushState for 50 different routes within 1 second: /dashboard, /media, /browse, /collections, /analytics, etc.
steps.expected: React Router handles rapid changes gracefully, no memory leak, no white screen, final route renders correctly, no pending state from intermediate routes

steps.name: Verify component cleanup
steps.action: Check browser memory usage and DOM node count after rapid switching
steps.expected: Memory usage is stable (no unbounded growth), no orphaned DOM nodes, no dangling event listeners, React Query cancels in-flight requests from abandoned routes

steps.name: Manipulate history stack
steps.action: Use history.replaceState to change the current URL to /admin without actually navigating, then click a link
steps.expected: React Router's internal state remains consistent, navigation works correctly regardless of history manipulation, route guards still enforce auth

steps.name: Push external URL to history
steps.action: Use history.pushState to add https://evil.com to the history stack, then press back button
steps.expected: Browser does not navigate to external URL from pushState (same-origin policy), SPA routing handles the back action gracefully

steps.name: Inject script in entity ID param
steps.action: Navigate to /entity/<script>alert(1)</script>
steps.expected: Route parameter is URL-encoded, no script execution, 404 or entity-not-found page shown, entity ID is treated as literal string

steps.name: Inject path traversal in param
steps.action: Navigate to /entity/../../admin
steps.expected: No path traversal occurs, React Router treats it as a literal entity ID, shows entity not found or 404 page

steps.name: Navigate with XSS in hash
steps.action: Navigate to /dashboard#
steps.expected: Hash fragment is not rendered as HTML, no script execution, dashboard loads normally, hash is ignored or URL-encoded in display

challenges.name: Deep Link to Non-Existent Entity ID

steps.name: Navigate to entity with invalid ID
steps.action: Navigate to /entity/999999999 (non-existent entity ID)
steps.expected: API returns 404, entity page shows a clear 'Entity not found' message with option to go back or browse, no white screen or unhandled error

steps.name: Navigate to entity with non-numeric ID
steps.action: Navigate to /entity/not-a-number
steps.expected: Page handles non-numeric ID gracefully, shows error or not-found page, no crash, no console errors

steps.name: Start save then navigate away
steps.action: Begin editing a collection name, click Save, immediately click a navigation link to /media before save completes
steps.expected: Either: (a) browser shows 'unsaved changes' confirmation dialog, or (b) save completes in background and navigation proceeds, or (c) save is cancelled. No silent data loss occurs.

steps.name: Delete entity then press back
steps.action: Navigate to an entity detail page, delete the entity, then press browser back button
steps.expected: Back button goes to the previous list page (not the deleted entity), if the deleted entity URL is reached it shows 'not found' rather than crashing

steps.name: Start upload and refresh page
steps.action: Begin a file upload operation, then press F5 or Ctrl+R to refresh the page
steps.expected: Browser shows 'leave page' confirmation dialog (beforeunload event), if confirmed: upload is cancelled, page reloads cleanly with no partial upload state

challenges.name: Bookmark Stale URL After Data Change

steps.name: Access bookmarked URL for deleted item
steps.action: Bookmark /entity/42, delete entity 42, close browser, reopen and navigate to bookmark
steps.expected: Page shows entity not found message with navigation options, not a blank screen or unhandled error

steps.name: Trigger popstate rapidly
steps.action: Navigate through 10 pages building up history, then rapidly click back button 10 times
steps.expected: Each back navigation renders the correct page content, no race conditions between route renders, final page matches expected history position

steps.name: Forward after multiple backs
steps.action: After going back 10 times, click forward 5 times rapidly
steps.expected: Forward navigation works correctly, correct pages render, no stale data from React Query cache

challenges.name: Direct URL Access to Protected Route While Logged Out

steps.name: Access admin page directly
steps.action: Clear all auth tokens, type http://localhost:3000/admin directly in address bar
steps.expected: Redirect to /login with returnUrl=/admin preserved, no admin content visible even briefly, after login redirects back to /admin

challenges.name: Paste Binary Data in Text Fields

steps.name: Paste binary data into search field
steps.action: Copy binary content (e.g., from an image file opened in hex editor) and paste into the media search input
steps.expected: Binary data is either rejected or displayed as garbled text, no crash, no unhandled exception, search executes safely with no results

steps.name: Submit collection creation while offline
steps.action: Navigate to /collections, start creating a new collection, disconnect network, click submit
steps.expected: Form shows a network error message, form data is preserved (not cleared), submit button re-enables, user can retry after reconnecting

steps.name: Reconnect and retry
steps.action: Reconnect network, click submit again
steps.expected: Form submits successfully with original data intact, collection is created, success toast appears

steps.name: Trigger browser autofill on login
steps.action: Allow browser to autofill username and password fields without any user interaction (keystrokes, clicks on the inputs)
steps.expected: React Hook Form detects autofilled values, validation runs correctly on submit, form does not submit with stale empty-string state

challenges.name: Form Field with maxLength Exceeded via Paste

steps.name: Paste text exceeding maxLength
steps.action: If a collection name field has maxLength=100, paste a 500-character string
steps.expected: Input is truncated to maxLength on paste, or Zod validation catches the overflow on submit with a clear error message like 'Name must be 100 characters or less'

steps.name: Enter zero-width characters in fields
steps.action: Paste a string containing zero-width spaces (U+200B), zero-width joiners (U+200D), and right-to-left marks (U+200F) into a search or name field
steps.expected: Application either strips invisible characters or handles them gracefully, search works correctly, no visual glitches in display, field appears empty if only invisible chars

steps.name: Double-click submit button rapidly
steps.action: Fill out a new collection form, rapidly double-click the submit button
steps.expected: Only one collection is created (not two duplicates), submit button is disabled after first click or second submission is debounced/deduplicated

challenges.name: Form Data Loss on Accidental Navigation

steps.name: Fill form then navigate away
steps.action: Start filling out a complex form (e.g., settings page with multiple fields changed), then click a navigation link
steps.expected: Browser shows a confirmation dialog warning about unsaved changes (via beforeunload or React Router prompt), user can cancel navigation and keep form data

steps.name: Trigger error with XSS in input
steps.action: Submit a form field with value <img/src=x onerror=alert(1)> that triggers a validation error which echoes the input
steps.expected: Error message displays the input as escaped text, no HTML rendering in error messages, React JSX escaping prevents injection

challenges.name: Form Memory Leak on Rapid Open/Close

steps.name: Rapidly open and close modal forms
steps.action: Open and close a create/edit modal dialog 50 times rapidly
steps.expected: Memory usage returns to baseline after modals are closed, no leaked DOM nodes, React Hook Form instances are properly cleaned up, no growing event listener count

steps.name: Password manager modifies DOM
steps.action: With a password manager extension active, observe login form behavior when extension injects its own UI elements
steps.expected: Form layout remains usable, extension icons do not break input styling, form submission still works correctly even with injected DOM elements

steps.name: Edit same entity in two tabs
steps.action: Open /entity/1 in two tabs, edit the name in tab 1 and save, then edit the name in tab 2 (which has stale data) and save
steps.expected: Either: (a) tab 2 gets a conflict error and is prompted to reload, or (b) last write wins but user is informed, no silent data corruption

steps.name: Search with regex special chars
steps.action: Type .*+?^${}()|[]\/ into the media search field and submit
steps.expected: Search treats input as literal text not regex, returns results matching the literal string or no results, no backend error, no 500 response

challenges.name: Entity with Extremely Long Title (1000+ chars)

steps.name: Display entity with 1000+ char title
steps.action: Navigate to an entity whose title is 1000+ characters long
steps.expected: Title is truncated with ellipsis or wrapped within its container, no horizontal overflow causing horizontal scrollbar, layout of other page elements is preserved

steps.name: Check tooltip or expand option
steps.action: Hover over or click the truncated title
steps.expected: Full title is accessible via tooltip, expand button, or detail view, truncation does not lose information permanently

steps.name: View entity with empty metadata
steps.action: Navigate to /entity/:id where the entity has no description, no year, no genre, no poster, no external metadata
steps.expected: Page renders with placeholder content or 'No information available' messages, no undefined/null text shown, layout is intact with empty state design

steps.name: Load browse page with 10000+ entities
steps.action: Navigate to /browse when the database contains 10000+ media items
steps.expected: Page uses pagination or virtual scrolling, initial load shows first page quickly (<2s), does not attempt to render all 10000 items at once

steps.name: Scroll through all items
steps.action: Rapidly scroll through the list continuously
steps.expected: Scroll performance remains smooth (no visible jank), virtual scroll recycles DOM nodes, memory usage stays bounded, no blank gaps during fast scroll

challenges.name: Image Load Failure for Entity Poster

steps.name: Entity with broken poster URL
steps.action: Navigate to an entity whose poster_url returns 404 or is an invalid URL
steps.expected: Fallback placeholder image or media-type icon is displayed, no broken image icon, no layout shift when fallback loads, alt text is descriptive

steps.name: Display entity with unknown media type
steps.action: View an entity whose media_type field is an unrecognized value not in the 11 known types
steps.expected: A generic fallback icon is shown instead of undefined or broken icon, no console error about missing icon component

steps.name: Display entity with corrupted UTF-8 bytes
steps.action: Navigate to an entity whose title contains invalid UTF-8 sequences (e.g., truncated multi-byte characters)
steps.expected: Browser renders replacement characters (U+FFFD) for invalid bytes, page does not crash, no JavaScript error thrown, layout remains stable

steps.name: View entity with HTML in description
steps.action: Navigate to an entity whose description field contains BoldClick
steps.expected: HTML tags are escaped and displayed as literal text, or sanitized (bold may render but scripts and javascript: links are stripped), no script execution

steps.name: View file with zero bytes
steps.action: Browse media list containing a file with size=0 bytes
steps.expected: File size displays as '0 B' or '0 bytes' (not NaN, undefined, or empty), file is listed normally with appropriate icon, no division-by-zero in any size calculations

steps.name: Display media with negative duration
steps.action: View a media item whose duration field is -120 (negative value from corrupted metadata)
steps.expected: Duration displays as 'Unknown' or '0:00' rather than '-2:00' or negative value, no NaN in duration calculations, progress bars handle it gracefully

steps.name: Display entity with future created_at
steps.action: View an entity whose created_at timestamp is in the year 2099
steps.expected: Date is displayed as-is or flagged as unusual, relative time display shows 'in X years' if using relative dates, no crash from future date arithmetic

challenges.name: Emoji and Special Unicode in Entity Title

steps.name: Display entity with complex Unicode
steps.action: View an entity with title containing emoji sequences, combining characters, and CJK characters
steps.expected: All characters render correctly, text measurement and truncation work properly with multi-byte characters, no garbled display or incorrect string length calculations

steps.name: Disconnect WebSocket during scan
steps.action: Start a media scan, then kill the WebSocket connection (e.g., via DevTools or network disruption) while scan progress events are streaming
steps.expected: UI shows a 'connection lost' indicator, scan continues on server side, WebSocket auto-reconnects and resumes receiving events, progress bar updates resume after reconnect

steps.name: Rapidly toggle WebSocket connection
steps.action: Programmatically open and close the WebSocket connection 20 times within 5 seconds
steps.expected: No connection leak (old connections are properly closed), exponential backoff prevents connection storm, server-side connection count does not grow unbounded

steps.name: Receive burst of WebSocket messages
steps.action: Trigger a scenario where the server sends 1000+ WebSocket messages in rapid succession (e.g., bulk scan events)
steps.expected: Client processes messages without UI freeze, messages are batched or throttled for rendering, no memory spike from queued unprocessed messages, React state updates are batched

steps.name: Receive malformed JSON via WebSocket
steps.action: Server sends a WebSocket message that is not valid JSON (e.g., truncated or binary data)
steps.expected: Client catches JSON parse error, logs warning, discards the malformed message, continues processing subsequent valid messages, no crash

steps.name: Load app while offline
steps.action: Set browser to offline mode, navigate to /dashboard which attempts WebSocket connection
steps.expected: WebSocket connection fails gracefully, UI shows offline indicator, app remains functional for cached data, connection retries with exponential backoff when online

steps.name: Server closes WebSocket
steps.action: Server sends a close frame with code 1001 (going away) due to server restart
steps.expected: Client handles close event, shows reconnecting indicator, automatically attempts reconnection with backoff, restores full functionality after server is back

steps.name: Verify exponential backoff
steps.action: Kill the server, observe WebSocket reconnection attempts in the network tab over 2 minutes
steps.expected: Reconnection intervals increase exponentially (e.g., 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, max 30s), not constant rapid polling, CPU/network usage stays low during reconnection

challenges.name: Stale WebSocket State After Long Idle

steps.name: Leave tab idle for 30 minutes
steps.action: Open /dashboard, leave the browser tab idle for 30+ minutes (potentially causing WebSocket timeout), then return to the tab
steps.expected: WebSocket reconnects on tab focus if connection was dropped, stale data is refreshed via React Query refetch on window focus, dashboard shows current state

steps.name: Token expires while WebSocket is active
steps.action: Login and establish WebSocket connection, wait for JWT to expire (or shorten expiry in test), observe behavior
steps.expected: Server closes WebSocket with auth error code, client detects auth failure, prompts re-login or attempts token refresh, does not continue with expired auth

steps.name: Open app in multiple tabs
steps.action: Open /dashboard in 5 different browser tabs, each establishing its own WebSocket connection
steps.expected: Each tab maintains its own WebSocket connection, server handles multiple connections per user, total connection count on server matches tab count, no duplicate event processing causing UI glitches

steps.name: Receive very large WebSocket message
steps.action: Server sends a WebSocket message with a 5MB JSON payload (e.g., scan results with thousands of files)
steps.expected: Client either processes the large message with acceptable delay (<2s) or the server chunks the response, no browser tab crash, no out-of-memory

challenges.name: Memory Leak on SPA Navigation (100+ Page Changes)

steps.name: Navigate 100+ times and measure memory
steps.action: Take a heap snapshot, then programmatically navigate between /dashboard, /media, /browse, /collections, /analytics, /settings 100 times, take another heap snapshot
steps.expected: Memory usage increase is less than 20% above baseline after GC, no detached DOM trees, no growing arrays of event listeners, React component unmount cleanup is complete

steps.name: Count DOM nodes during navigation
steps.action: Record document.querySelectorAll('*').length on /dashboard, navigate to /media, navigate back to /dashboard, repeat 20 times
steps.expected: DOM node count returns to approximately the same value on each /dashboard visit (within 10% variance), no monotonic increase indicating leaked nodes

steps.name: Monitor Zustand store growth
steps.action: Open React DevTools, monitor Zustand store size as user navigates through 50 different entity pages and performs 20 searches
steps.expected: Zustand store size stays bounded, old search results are evicted, entity detail cache has a maximum size, store does not grow linearly with interactions

steps.name: Block lazy chunk loading
steps.action: Navigate to /dashboard, then block network requests matching *.chunk.js patterns, click to navigate to /analytics (lazy loaded)
steps.expected: React Suspense fallback UI is shown, error boundary catches the chunk load failure, user sees a 'Failed to load page' message with a retry button, not a white screen

steps.name: Retry after unblocking
steps.action: Unblock network and click retry button
steps.expected: Lazy chunk loads successfully, /analytics page renders correctly

steps.name: Profile framer-motion animations
steps.action: Open Performance tab in DevTools, record while navigating between pages (framer-motion page transitions) and opening modal dialogs
steps.expected: Frame rate stays above 30fps during animations, no layout thrashing (forced reflows), animations use transform/opacity (GPU-composited), no animation on layout-triggering properties (width, height, top, left)

steps.name: Scroll through large media grid
steps.action: Load /browse with 1000+ media items visible (if virtualization is off or broken), scroll rapidly up and down
steps.expected: Scroll is smooth at 60fps if virtualized, or gracefully degrades with slight jank if not virtualized, no complete UI freeze, no dropped frames lasting more than 100ms

steps.name: Visit many unique entity pages
steps.action: Navigate to 200 different /entity/:id pages, each triggering unique React Query cache entries
steps.expected: React Query gcTime/staleTime settings cause old entries to be garbage collected, cache size plateaus rather than growing linearly, memory usage stays bounded

steps.name: Perform many state-changing operations
steps.action: Add 50 items to favorites, create 20 playlists, perform 100 searches, toggle 30 filter combinations
steps.expected: Zustand store does not retain all historical state, completed operations are cleaned up, memory for store remains under 5MB total

challenges.name: Tab with 100+ Media Items Open for 1 Hour

steps.name: Leave media-heavy page open
steps.action: Navigate to /browse showing 100+ media items with thumbnails, leave tab open for 1 hour
steps.expected: Memory usage stays stable over time, no growth from setInterval/setTimeout leaks, no accumulating WebSocket messages, React Query refetch intervals do not cause memory buildup

steps.name: Browse through many entity posters
steps.action: Scroll through /browse loading 500+ entity poster images
steps.expected: Images outside the viewport are unloaded or use low-res thumbnails, visible image count stays bounded via lazy loading (loading='lazy' or IntersectionObserver), total image memory stays under 200MB

steps.name: Measure initial page load weight
steps.action: Open /login with cache disabled, measure total transferred bytes in Network tab
steps.expected: Initial page load is under 500KB (gzipped/brotli), vendor chunks are cached separately, no single chunk exceeds 250KB compressed

steps.name: Disable localStorage and load app
steps.action: Block localStorage access (private browsing in some browsers or manual override), navigate to /login
steps.expected: App detects localStorage unavailability, shows a clear error message like 'This application requires localStorage to function', does not crash with SecurityError

steps.name: Block all cookies and load app
steps.action: Disable cookies in browser settings, navigate to http://localhost:3000
steps.expected: Application functions with localStorage-based auth (JWT), cookie blocking does not prevent login, if cookies are required show clear error message

steps.name: Use app in incognito/private mode
steps.action: Open browser in private/incognito mode, navigate to /login, login, browse media
steps.expected: Full app functionality works in private mode, localStorage is available (in private mode in modern browsers), no quota exceeded errors, session works until window is closed

steps.name: Disable CSS and view app
steps.action: Disable all stylesheets in DevTools, navigate through the app
steps.expected: HTML structure is semantic and readable without CSS, form elements are still functional, content hierarchy is understandable, no content hidden solely via CSS that should be accessible

steps.name: Zoom to 400% and navigate
steps.action: Set browser zoom to 400%, navigate through /login, /dashboard, /browse, /settings
steps.expected: All content remains accessible (no hidden overflow), text is readable, buttons are clickable, no overlapping elements, scroll works to reach all content, meets WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow

steps.name: Disable images and view app
steps.action: Block all image loading in browser settings, navigate through the app
steps.expected: All images have meaningful alt text, media type icons have aria-labels, layout does not break without images, placeholder sizing prevents layout shift

steps.name: Navigate with screen reader
steps.action: Enable a screen reader (NVDA/VoiceOver), navigate through /login, /dashboard, /browse
steps.expected: All interactive elements are announced with roles and labels, page regions have landmarks, heading hierarchy is logical (h1>h2>h3), focus order matches visual order, dynamic content changes are announced via aria-live regions

steps.name: Enable forced colors / high contrast
steps.action: Enable Windows High Contrast mode or use forced-colors CSS media query emulation in DevTools, navigate through the app
steps.expected: All text meets contrast requirements, interactive elements are distinguishable, focus indicators are visible, custom colors gracefully degrade to system colors, no information conveyed by color alone

steps.name: Print preview on various pages
steps.action: Open print preview (Ctrl+P) on /dashboard, /browse, /entity/:id
steps.expected: Print output is readable and meaningful, navigation sidebar and non-essential UI are hidden via @media print, data tables and entity details are formatted for print, no blank pages

steps.name: Use app with battery saver enabled
steps.action: Enable battery saver mode in OS (which throttles background tabs and timers), use the app actively
steps.expected: WebSocket reconnection still works (may be delayed), animations degrade gracefully (requestAnimationFrame throttled), no critical functionality broken by timer throttling

steps.name: Simulate slow 3G connection
steps.action: In DevTools, set network throttling to Slow 3G (400kbps), navigate to /login and login
steps.expected: Loading indicators are visible during slow requests, UI does not appear broken during loading, timeout errors show clear messages, form submission shows pending state

steps.name: Navigate away and back via bfcache
steps.action: Navigate to /dashboard, navigate to an external page, press back button (triggering bfcache restore)
steps.expected: Page restores from bfcache with correct state, WebSocket reconnects if needed, data is refetched if stale, no frozen/broken UI from cached page state

steps.name: Simulate all API endpoints returning 500
steps.action: Configure API to return 500 Internal Server Error for all requests, login as admin (cached token), navigate to /dashboard
steps.expected: Dashboard shows error states for all widgets ('Failed to load data' or similar), no white screen, error boundary catches component-level failures, user can still navigate to other pages

steps.name: Verify retry behavior
steps.action: Observe React Query retry behavior in network tab
steps.expected: React Query retries failed requests (default 3 times with backoff), after all retries fail shows persistent error state with manual retry button

steps.name: API returns invalid JSON response
steps.action: Configure API to return truncated/malformed JSON (e.g., {"data": [{ instead of valid JSON), navigate to /media
steps.expected: JSON parse error is caught by API client layer, error state is shown in the UI, no unhandled promise rejection, error message is user-friendly (not raw SyntaxError)

steps.name: Add 10-second latency to all requests
steps.action: Use DevTools to add 10000ms latency to all network requests, navigate through the app
steps.expected: Loading spinners/skeletons are shown immediately, requests are not duplicated by impatient clicks, timeout handling kicks in at reasonable threshold (e.g., 30s), timeout message is clear

steps.name: Trigger CORS error
steps.action: Configure API to not include Access-Control-Allow-Origin header, make a request from the frontend
steps.expected: CORS error is caught and displayed as a connection error (not exposed as a CORS error to the user), error message suggests checking server connectivity

steps.name: Enforce strict CSP and verify compliance
steps.action: Add strict Content-Security-Policy header (script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:), load the app
steps.expected: No CSP violations in console, all scripts loaded from same origin, no inline scripts (except nonce-based), Tailwind CSS styles work (no inline style violations), images use allowed sources

steps.name: Check for mixed content
steps.action: If the app is served over HTTPS, verify no HTTP resources are loaded (images, scripts, API calls, WebSocket)
steps.expected: No mixed content warnings in console, all resource URLs use protocol-relative or HTTPS, WebSocket uses wss:// not ws:// when on HTTPS

steps.name: Attempt to embed app in iframe
steps.action: Create an HTML page that embeds http://localhost:3000 in an iframe, open the outer page
steps.expected: App refuses to render in iframe due to X-Frame-Options: DENY or Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none' header, iframe shows blank or error

steps.name: Verify security headers
steps.action: Inspect HTTP response headers for the main page load
steps.expected: X-Frame-Options header is present (DENY or SAMEORIGIN), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff is present, Referrer-Policy is set, Strict-Transport-Security if HTTPS

steps.name: Trigger rate limiting
steps.action: Rapidly submit login form 20 times within 10 seconds to trigger the rate limiter (5 requests/min on login)
steps.expected: After rate limit is hit, API returns 429 Too Many Requests, UI shows clear message like 'Too many attempts, please try again in X seconds', subsequent attempts show countdown timer

steps.name: Simulate stale cache serving old assets
steps.action: After a deployment, simulate a scenario where the HTML file references new chunk hashes but the CDN still serves old chunk files (cache mismatch)
steps.expected: Chunk loading failure is caught by error boundary, user sees 'New version available, please refresh' message, or the app auto-reloads to get fresh assets

steps.name: API request exceeds timeout
steps.action: Trigger an API call that takes longer than the client-side timeout (e.g., a complex search that hangs for 60s when timeout is 30s)
steps.expected: Client aborts the request after timeout, shows 'Request timed out' error, offers retry option, AbortController properly cancels the fetch

steps.name: API returns 200 with empty body
steps.action: Configure an API endpoint to return 200 OK with an empty response body (no JSON)
